paragraphs: Mentioned in Berakhot, chapter 2, halakhah 4, and at the beginning of Megillah, chapter 2. R' Yose, R' Yonah’s colleague, said, “Nachman the Elder recited.”[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: Berakhot chapter 2 halakhah 4 and beginning of Megillah chapter 2 are explicit abbreviated locators. Jerusalem Talmud is suggested by context, not named or independently edition-verified.

סבא is the Elder (also grandfather), not a supplied Rabbi title. תני with named subject is read as recited/taught, not an imperative instruction or a personal occupational designation. The source only gives this introductory formula; a specific following baraita is not supplied.
Hyman’s colleague identification is preserved parenthetically in sense. Neither abbreviated Yose nor Yonah title is expanded from familiarity.
